reviewed_by: Codex; original feedback mechanism independently validated by two fresh read-only diagnoses; failing PTY and LAN fixtures independently diagnosed
reason: The paired CLI now uses a full-screen prompt_toolkit view and reports stream acceptance, tool progress, answers and actionable failures. Select deterministic TUI rendering/keyboard/resize tests, existing shell/packaging contracts, the disposable authenticated TLS LAN Core journey, and exact product-help/destination discovery checks. The client matrix runs these standalone tests on Linux and macOS with Python 3.11-3.13. PTY assertions replay ANSI output through the test-only pyte terminal emulator, avoiding false failures from valid partial redraws. An actual PTY F4 case verifies command access and preservation of an unsent draft.
exclusions: No browser or native UI behavior changes: the settings catalog keyword edit has one direct frontend contract. Playwright mobile/desktop layouts are inapplicable to a terminal surface. No real providers, production Core, operator data, full suites, unrelated regression areas, or release tag.
